title: Reading Practice Test 17 – Construction & Engineering
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: biển báo công trường, thư mời thầu, bài báo có chèn câu, báo giá và e-mail). Chủ đề: xây dựng, cải tạo, công trình xanh.

questions.content: The construction of the new bridge is expected to be ------- by the end of next year.
questions.explanation: Sau 'be' cần tính từ: 'be complete' = hoàn thành.

questions.content: All workers on the site must wear a helmet at ------- times.
questions.explanation: Cụm cố định 'at all times' = mọi lúc. 'every/each' đi với danh từ số ít.

questions.content: The architect ------- several changes to the design after meeting with the client.
questions.explanation: Hành động đã xảy ra sau cuộc gặp (quá khứ) → 'made'; 'make changes' = thực hiện thay đổi.

questions.content: The engineers are ------- confident that the tunnel will open on time.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'confident' → 'reasonably confident' (khá tự tin).

questions.content: ------- the rain, construction continued as planned.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ 'the rain', ý nhượng bộ → 'Despite'.

questions.content: The city has hired an engineering firm to ------- the safety of the old stadium.
questions.explanation: 'to + V nguyên mẫu' chỉ mục đích → 'assess' (đánh giá).

questions.content: Materials for the project ------- from local suppliers whenever possible.
questions.explanation: Vật liệu 'được mua' → bị động hiện tại 'are purchased'.

questions.content: The new office tower will be the ------- building in the city when it is completed.
questions.explanation: 'the … in the city' → so sánh nhất của tính từ ngắn: 'the tallest'.

questions.content: Road repairs on Elm Street will cause ------- delays during rush hour.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'delays' → 'minor delays' (chậm trễ nhỏ).

questions.content: The concrete foundation must be allowed to dry ------- before the walls are built.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'dry' → trạng từ 'completely' (khô hoàn toàn).

groups.passage:
Dear Ms. Grant,

I am writing to update you on the renovation of your restaurant's kitchen. The new ventilation system ---131--- on Monday, and the electrical work is nearly finished.

Unfortunately, the floor tiles you selected are ---132--- out of stock. The supplier expects a new shipment in two weeks. ---133---. Alternatively, we can use a similar tile that is available now. I have attached a photo for your review.

Please let me know which option you prefer by Wednesday ---134--- we can keep the project on schedule.

Best regards,
Tom Reyes
Reyes Construction

questions.explanation: Hệ thống thông gió 'đã được lắp' vào thứ Hai vừa rồi → bị động quá khứ 'was installed'.
Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho cụm 'out of stock' → 'temporarily' (tạm thời hết hàng).

options.A: Waiting for them would delay completion by about ten days.

questions.explanation: Nêu hệ quả của việc chờ hàng (chậm tiến độ), trước khi đưa ra phương án thay thế 'Alternatively…'.
Chỉ mục đích (để giữ đúng tiến độ) → 'so that'.

options.A: Check in at the site office

groups.passage:
Request for Proposals

The Town of Fairview invites qualified contractors to submit proposals for the renovation of the Fairview Community Center. The project includes replacing the roof, upgrading the heating system, and making the building fully accessible to people with disabilities.

Proposals must include a detailed cost estimate, a project timeline, and references from at least three similar projects completed in the past five years. Contractors must be licensed in the state.

Proposals are due by 4:00 P.M. on March 15 and may be submitted by e-mail or delivered to Town Hall. A site visit for interested contractors will be held on March 1 at 10:00 A.M.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the document?

options.B: To request bids for a renovation

questions.explanation: Mời nhà thầu nộp hồ sơ đề xuất cho dự án cải tạo trung tâm cộng đồng.

questions.content: What is NOT required in the proposals?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: hồ sơ yêu cầu dự toán, tiến độ, người tham chiếu – không yêu cầu ảnh công trình cũ.

questions.content: What will happen on March 1?
questions.explanation: 'A site visit for interested contractors will be held on March 1.' Hạn nộp là 15/3.

groups.passage:
Green Buildings on the Rise
By Samuel Park

More developers are designing buildings that use less energy and water, according to a report by the Green Building Council. Last year, 38 percent of new commercial buildings in the country earned an environmental certification, compared with 25 percent five years earlier. [1]

Green buildings often cost more to construct. However, owners usually recover the extra costs within a few years through lower utility bills. [2] Tenants also appear willing to pay higher rents for offices with better air quality and natural light.

One example is the Harborview Tower in Seattle, which opened last spring. [3] The 30-story building uses solar panels, collects rainwater for its gardens, and has reduced its energy use by 45 percent compared with similar buildings. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.A: The growth of environmentally friendly buildings
options.D: A new type of solar panel

questions.explanation: Bài viết về xu hướng công trình xanh (tiết kiệm năng lượng, nước) ngày càng tăng.

questions.content: According to the article, how do owners recover the extra costs?
questions.explanation: '…owners usually recover the extra costs within a few years through lower utility bills.'

questions.content: The word "recover" in paragraph 2, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'recover the extra costs' = thu hồi lại chi phí → regain. 'heal' (hồi phục sức khoẻ) là nghĩa khác – bẫy.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"It was designed by the award-winning firm Lindqvist Architects."
questions.explanation: 'It' chỉ Harborview Tower vừa được giới thiệu → vị trí [3].

groups.passage:
Estimate – Clearview Windows & Doors
Customer: Rosa Delgado, 18 Birch Lane
Date: May 5

Replace 8 windows (double-glazed, white frames) – $4,800
Replace front door (steel, with glass panel) – $1,200
Removal and disposal of old windows and door – $400
Labor – $1,600
Total estimate: $8,000

This estimate is valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit is required to schedule installation. Installation can typically begin within three weeks of the deposit.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: estimates@clearviewwindows.com
From: Rosa Delgado
Date: May 12
Subject: Estimate for 18 Birch Lane

Hello,

Thank you for the estimate. I would like to proceed with the window replacement. However, I have decided to keep my current front door for now, so please remove that item from the estimate.

I would also like to change the frame color to black, if possible. Please let me know whether this affects the price.

I am traveling for work from June 1 to June 10, so I would prefer the installation to take place after I return. I can pay the deposit this week.

Best regards,
Rosa Delgado

questions.content: What is included in the estimate?
questions.explanation: 'Removal and disposal of old windows and door – $400.' (D) sai: tiền công $1,600.

questions.content: What does Ms. Delgado ask about?

options.A: Whether a color change will affect the cost
options.B: Whether she can pay in installments
options.C: How long the windows will last
options.D: Where the company's office is located

questions.explanation: 'I would also like to change the frame color to black… Please let me know whether this affects the price.'

questions.content: What is suggested about the estimate?

options.B: It had not expired when Ms. Delgado responded.
options.D: It requires full payment in advance.

questions.explanation: Báo giá lập ngày 5/5, hiệu lực 30 ngày; cô trả lời ngày 12/5 → báo giá vẫn còn hiệu lực.

questions.content: When will the installation most likely take place?

options.C: During the first week of June

questions.explanation: Cô đi công tác 1–10/6 và muốn lắp đặt sau khi về → sau ngày 10/6.

questions.content: What does Ms. Delgado plan to do this week?
questions.explanation: 'I can pay the deposit this week.' (B) diễn ra vào tháng Sáu.
